name: run-record
title: Procedure execution record
for_each: select id,code from runs order by code

sections.title: Steps and ownership
sections.sql: select position,name,owner,due_on,state from tasks where run_id=$1 order by position

sections.title: Evidence and blockers
sections.sql: select position,evidence,block_reason,to_char(completed_at at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as completed_utc from tasks where run_id=$1 order by position

sections.title: Decision record
sections.sql: select actor,action,detail,created_at from events where run_id=$1 order by created_at

name: procedure-sheet
title: Approved procedure sheet
for_each: select id,code||'-v'||version as name from procedures order by code,version

sections.title: Approved steps
sections.sql: select ordinality as position,step->>'name' as name,step->>'owner' as owner,step->>'days' as due_days_after_launch from procedures p,jsonb_array_elements(p.steps) with ordinality as s(step,ordinality) where p.id=$1
